actions: Continue to allocate $15,000/month for incremental morning labor at 12 shops near Starbucks pilot cafés.
Continue to allocate $15,000/month for geo-targeted $1 Order Ahead app offer for new/lapsed users at 12 shops near Starbucks pilot cafés.
moves.rationale: Starbucks' capacity reservation policy remains in effect for February 2027, creating an ongoing opportunity to capture customers experiencing delays or abandonment. Our initial actions in January were designed to capitalize on this by improving service speed and attracting new users to our convenient drive-through and Order Ahead options. Without new data from January to suggest a change is necessary, continuing this consistent and coherent strategy for February allows us to maintain momentum, reinforce our service proposition, and gather more observations on customer behavior. This approach directly supports our incentives to turn frustrated morning demand into repeat visits and ensure existing-shop growth is durable.
resource_commitments: Allocate $15,000 for incremental morning labor for February 2027.
Allocate $15,000 for geo-targeted $1 Order Ahead app offers for new/lapsed users for February 2027.
expected_responses: Starbucks will likely continue to focus on its internal pilot metrics and observe the effects of its capacity reservation policy. They may notice some shifts in market share but are unlikely to alter their pre-planned pilot strategy in February.

Dunkin will continue to monitor the performance of its $6 breakfast Meal Deal. If they observe a significant shift in morning traffic towards drive-through competitors, they might consider adjusting their own offers or service, but their primary focus remains on their value and food proposition.
